data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Stonecradle Turns as Six Fronts Stay Hot
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Three hours onward the ledger shows a sharp turn at Stonecradle, now three Warden, six Colonial with one held no longer on either side of the old count, after 27 changes in the day and five in the last two hours about The Heir's Knife, Trammel Pool and World's End, the latest entry in the packet with heavy two-hour losses at 279 Colonial to 328 Warden. Godcrofts stands four apiece with one destroyed after 16 daily changes and three in two hours about The Axehead, Argosa and Fleecewatch, also entered to the hour. Linn Mercy holds one Warden, nine Colonial and one destroyed after 20 daily changes and two in two hours about The Long Whine and Ulster Falls. Fisherman's Row, four to five, reports 13 daily changes and six in two hours about Arcadia, Eidolo and Dankana Post. The Shelf counts seven to two after 50 daily changes and eight in six, quiet in the last two, while the Weathered Expanse, six to three after 59 daily changes, shows 13 in six and none in two about Wightwalk and Frostmarch. Callahan's Passage, Farranac Coast, Viper Pit, Dead Lands and Marban Hollow report no flips in the last six hours.
